answer: An escrow bond plus a referral graph blocks fakes. Newcomers post a bond worth 2x their 30-day earnings, locked 20 epochs, and name a sponsor whose bond is slashed if they cheat. Links are published, so the graph acts as a lantern: a plume-shaped fan from one sponsor shows up, and peers may wander in to dispute a cluster, triggering an audit burning fakes' bonds. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 bonds; an honest agent pays once, undiluted.
